beforeShellExecution.command: d="$PWD"; while [ "$d" != / ] && [ ! -x "$d/.claude/gate.sh" ]; do d="$(dirname "$d")"; done; if [ -x "$d/.claude/gate.sh" ]; then exec "$d/.claude/gate.sh" full --event=cursor-shell; else echo "Gate script .claude/gate.sh not found; nothing was verified." >&2; exit 2; fi

stop.command: d="$PWD"; while [ "$d" != / ] && [ ! -x "$d/.claude/gate.sh" ]; do d="$(dirname "$d")"; done; if [ -x "$d/.claude/gate.sh" ]; then exec "$d/.claude/gate.sh" fast --event=cursor-stop; fi
